recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-39205; future RSG terminology maintenance should occur in THO, and future extension binding maintenance should occur in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-39205 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested removal of the invalid DICOM Patient Sex code 0010,0040 from the recorded sex or gender type value set, removal of LOINC 76691-5 Gender identity, addition of LOINC 74698-2 Sex [AHRQ], and changing recordedSexOrGender.type from a preferred binding to an example binding.
initial_application: Core commit bfbc0c259439edf33cc2df93436c5ed2311d2855 removed the DICOM include from source/patient/valueset-recorded-sex-or-gender-type.xml. FHIR Extension Pack commits 789f5717a14b3d7a46690e767e48a9962a4e0f0c and d93382e3d6a7e0b44a1fb04fe905035170721fe5 applied the binding-strength and LOINC code changes after the GHP material moved there.
additional_context: Core commit f3c0d3659cb93c99329c153a85820bb086df832f deleted the GHP terminology resources from core after moving them to the extension IG, and extension-pack commit 7e35b16da7d2e939acaa4f644b87d916c0e3937c later removed the terminology resources after moving them to THO. Current core fhir.ini has no active recorded-sex-or-gender-type value set or individual-recordedSexOrGender profile entry. Current Extension Pack source has the individual-recordedSexOrGender.type binding strength as example, and the current THO value set contains LOINC 46098-0, 76689-9, and 74698-2 only.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active FHIR-core source has no remaining incorrect DICOM, 76691-5, 74698-2, or binding-strength content to edit, and the current authoritative external artifacts already match the published resolution.
